newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 13.
newsitem.headline: Mexican daily port, shipping update for Feb. 13.

text.p: Two major Mexican ports were reported closed Thursday, the Communications and Transport Ministry said in its 1000 local/1600 GMT daily meteorological report.
Gulf of Mexico ports Tampico in Tamaulipas state and Veracruz in Veracruz state were reported closed because of winds from the north between 35 and 45 km per hour and waves at six to eight feet high.
The ministry said Tuxpan, Frontera, Nautla, Alvarado, La Pesca and El Mezquital were shut to smaller tourism and fishing boats. Ships were advised
to exercise caution in the northern Gulf of Mexico because of strong winds and high waves.
The ministry updated port conditions and shipping warnings for the Gulf of Mexico, Caribbean and Pacific Coast.

Cold front possibly bringing rain along Baja California peninsula and Sonora state. Winds expected up to 25 knots (47 km/28 miles per hour) with waves of three to six feet high along coasts of Sinaloa and Sonora.

Clouds and disperse rains in northwest gulf region. Winds in the region from 10 to 20 knots (19 to 38 km/11 to 22 miles per hour) and waves six to nine feet high. Wind gusts up to 57 km/33 miles per hour.
Partly cloudy skies with isolated showers and moderate winds from southeast at 20 to 30 km.
